pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v1.16
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p] Numbers were getting stuck at 1.00Dc - fixed, the count now goes way beyond!
[/p][/*][*][p] Midnight Craving achievement now triggers immediately when you launch the game between midnight and 4 AM
[/p][/*][*][p] Leaderboard scores were displaying as giant corrupted numbers for some players - fixed
[/p][/*][*][p] Owned cursors (Cheese/Pepperoni) were appearing locked in the skin menu - fixed

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v1.17
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leaderboard scores with very high values now display correctly (e.g. e+815) instead of showing corrupted numbers
[*] Fixed leaderboard scores displaying as oversized numbers for some players
[*] Leaderboard scores will automatically refresh on next game launch
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]🎨 Collection System[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Collection panel with 3 categories: Cursors, Pizzas, Delivery
[*] Pizza skins: Margherita, Pepperoni, 4 Stagioni - unlock by reaching new pizza recipes
[*] New Gold Delivery Scooter skin - obtainable as a random Steam drop while playing!
[/list]
[h3]✨ Visual Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Animated oven, factory, buildings and delivery scooter
[/list]
[h3]🏆 New Achievements (7 new)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Viva la Pizza! - Return to Pizza Empire
[*] Lunch Break - Play between 11am and 2pm
[*] Pizzaholic - Play 7 days in a row
[*] It's Not Delivery... - Earn €1M with oven only
[*] Side Hustle - Earn €1M with delivery only
[*] Weapon of Mass Production - Earn €1M with factory only
[*] Golden Fever - Earn 1,000,000 pizzas during a single Golden Bonus
[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leaderboard scores with very high values now display correctly instead of showing corrupted numbers
[*] Leaderboard scores will automatically refresh on next game launch
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.1
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a critical exploit where spamming the Ascension/Prestige button could open multiple panels simultaneously, allowing players to confirm multiple ascensions in seconds - leaderboard scores affected by this exploit will be reset with the arrival of Season 1 🍕
[*] Fixed tooltips getting stuck when hovering quickly over locked collection items
[*] Fixed the "Earn €1,000,000 with a single upgrade" achievement not unlocking correctly
[/list]
[h3]✨ New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] 4 new delivery skins: Ghost Rider, Tokyo Night, T-Rex Rider, Magic Carpet
[*] 2 new cursor skins: Rainbow Slice, Sea Slice
[*] New CRAFT tab in the Collection - combine 10 items of the same rarity to craft 1 item of the next rarity (Common → Uncommon → Rare → Legendary)
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.2
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]✨ New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added VIVA LA PIZZA! achievement retroactive unlock - if you already played before the achievement was added, it will automatically unlock on your next launch
[*] Added Bug Hunter Slice - an exclusive legendary cursor skin awarded to players who help improve the game 🐛
[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Collection panel not displaying items immediately when opened
[*] Fixed a "NEW ITEM!" notification incorrectly triggering every time the Collection panel was opened
[*] Fixed the inventory refresh looping infinitely in the background, causing performance issues
[*] Fixed a crash when closing the Collection or Craft panel very quickly after opening it
[/list]
[h3]🌍 Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Translated all Craft UI elements into all 17 supported languages (tab name, rarity names, button states, Last Drop label)
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.3
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]✨ New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Discord Rich Presence - show off your Pizza Empire progress to your friends directly in Discord 🍕
[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the menu button not being accessible while the Upgrades panel was open
[*] Fixed the Collection panel not closing when opening the Help screen
[/list]
[h3]✨ Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Item tooltips now show specific unlock information depending on the item - daily drop, click-based unlock, or exclusive
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.4
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]✨ New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] 3 new cursor skins - find them in the Collection! 🍕
[*] 2 new plane skins - Rainbow Plane and Electro Plane, now droppable from the Pizza Box!
[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Legendary craft - not all Rare items were available as crafting ingredients
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.5
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]🏆 Season 1 - Now Live![/h3]
[list]
[*] Season 1 has officially started! It runs for 2 months, from March 28 at 1:00 PM UTC to May 28, 2026.
[*] 3 new exclusive Season 1 items are now droppable from the Pizza Box - the Season 1 Slice, Season 1 Scooter and Season 1 Plane. These items will only drop during Season 1, but remain tradeable forever once obtained!
[*] The Season 1 leaderboard is now live - scores reset and a new competition begins. Good luck! 🍕
[/list]
[h3]🐣 Easter 2026 Event[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Easter event is now live! 3 limited Easter items are droppable from the Pizza Box - the Easter Slice, Easter Bunny Scooter and Easter Plane.
[*] These items are only available until April 5, 2026 at 11:59 PM (Paris time). Don't miss them!
[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Inventory not loading for some Russian players - this issue is still being investigated, we're working on a fix.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.6
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the 7 days in a row achievement (Pizzaholic) not unlocking when the game was left running overnight - the game now tracks the date change in real time.
[*] Added a protection against macro and auto-clicker abuse on ascensions.
[/list]
If you're experiencing any issues, don't hesitate to reach out in the Community Hub - I'm very active there and happy to help! And if you're enjoying the game, a review goes a long way 🍕

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.7
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]✨ Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The stats panel now shows a 🔥 LOGIN STREAK: X days counter so you can track your progress directly in-game.
[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Pizzaholic achievement (7 days in a row) now saves your login immediately on launch, even for short sessions.
[*] Day streak detection is now more robust - days are sorted and deduplicated before counting, preventing any ordering issues.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.8

pending.contents:

[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several item name display issues in the craft panel.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.9
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]✨ New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the 🌸 Pink Slice - a new rare cursor skin, obtainable through drops!
[/list]
[h3]🛡️ Improvements[/h3]
[list]

[*] Added protections to prevent abusive rapid ascensions.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.10
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
🏴‍☠️

[b]Season 1 ends on 28 May 2026.[/b] The Season 1 exclusive items will no longer be obtainable after that date.

Season 2 begins on 28 May 2026, right when Season 1 ends. New exclusive items are now available to collect!

Complete UI overhaul.

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Season 2 is LIVE!
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
Season 2 is now LIVE!

The Season 1 leaderboards are now locked - your final scores are saved. A new era begins!

[h3]✨ What's New[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Season 2 Leaderboards[/b] - fresh rankings for Total Pizzas, Prestiges & Total Money. Everyone starts from zero. Climb back to the top!
[*] [b]4 new S2 items[/b] - now available from the daily Pizza Box.
[*] Season 1 exclusives have been removed from the drop pool.
[/list]

Keep clicking, keep ascending. See you at the top! 👑

Bando.

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.12
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a graphics glitch that could cause a corrupted/garbled screen on startup on some Windows setups (DirectX rendering issue).
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.13
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]✨ New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards now show the full player list, page by page - click a player's photo to view their Steam profile.
[/list]
[h3]🎨 Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the Crafting tab for better usability.
[*] Refreshed several in-game assets and icons.
[*] Crafting now shows a clear "in progress" state and displays the item you just received, with less waiting.
[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several Steamworks Inventory sync issues that could prevent Collection/Crafting items from loading or displaying correctly.
[*] Fixed the Golden Pizza sometimes not registering clicks.
[*] Fixed the Craft button getting stuck if a craft attempt failed.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.14
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Halloween event from October 20 to November 3: spooky night theme, a pumpkin Golden Pizza, and Golden Pizzas show up more often.
[*] 4 limited Halloween items in the Pizza Box: Pumpkin Slice, Pumpkin Pizza, Skeleton Rider, Haunted Plane.
[*] New "Random" option for delivery drivers and planes in the Collection: a different skin every time.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ovens, restaurants and factories redrawn in pixel art, with animated smoke and lights.
[*] New pixel art and animations for the default, Gold, Tokyo Night and S1 scooters and the Electro Plane.
[*] New, smaller Golden Pizza.
[*] Cleaner screen: building counters and level labels removed.
[*] The default cursor now shows its real look in the Collection.
[*] Updated Steam inventory icons for several scooters and the Electro Plane.
[*] Lots of behind-the-scenes cleanup for a more stable game.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Season 2 items that could not be used in crafting.
[*] Fixed some rare items missing from the rare crafting recipe.
[*] Fixed the S1 Plane skin not displaying.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.15
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pizza Empire is now available on Linux and Steam Deck, natively.
[*] Supporter Pack DLC: 4 exclusive gold items (Supporter Slice, Diamond Pizza, VIP Rider, Golden Jet) and a Supporter badge on the leaderboard. Cosmetic only. The game stays free, with no ads.
[*] Leaderboard: your own rank is now always shown at the bottom.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Much lighter game: capped at 60 FPS and slowed down when the window is in the background. Less CPU, less battery.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.16

[/list]
